title: A Inventory for the Undertow
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Emrys Brightwater, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
